name: Kemomimi Harem Vacation ~Inaka de Nonbiri Mofumofu Kemonomimi Shoujo-tachi to Kozukuri Zanmai~
original_name: けもみみハーレム化け～しょん ～田舎でのんびりもふもふ獣耳少女たちと子作り三昧～
source:
Figurative tail tucked between his legs,
the protagonist abandoned the city for his hometown, his dreams broken.
Luckily, he was comforted by four girls from childhood...
but while it's good to see them -- and live with them! -- something's weird.
The girls have actual tails, and furry ears like spirit animals.

Create a harem with these four youkai-like girls
in a slow-life ADV game with fast-and-intense erotica! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179494.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公像夹着尾巴一样，梦想破碎后离开城市回到故乡。

幸运的是，四名青梅竹马的女孩安慰了他……但和她们重逢、甚至一起生活本该很棒，却总觉得哪里不对。

女孩们真的有尾巴，耳朵也像灵兽一样毛茸茸的。

在这款慢生活ADV中，与四名妖怪般的兽耳少女组成后宫，享受快速而激烈的色情内容！
